scope: The shared interaction helper chooses the supported 2D renderer; those scenario passes are not 3D performance acceptance.

WebKit used no private protocol or synthesized focus events.
Native audio passes verify actual decode/start/stop/gain interactions, not human listening.
Native CDP touch passes are not physical-phone verification.
All product sources unchanged by this review.

limits: 25 PASS / 7 FAIL in 32 automatic UI executions. One full FP02 2D match; no executor-operated play.
Four map jobs observed SERVER_BUSY. FP02 3D instead timed out after 1500ms while scrolling an enabled stable fighter button; no overload pause was observed in that job.
Both focus tests failed the real-event precondition. Downstream release and stable-ammunition assertions did not execute.
Native audio verifies decoding and voices, not listening. Native CDP touch is not a physical-phone check.
Scene phase instrumentation excludes React render/commit, async model completion and GPU completion. It does not identify the cause of slow SwiftShader frame intervals.
Storage and map jobs run on separate CI machines. Their timing distributions cannot be correlated as one event trace.
Transaction-minus-body is not exact fsync time. Syscall wall time includes descheduling and tracer overhead.
No public Forpost release or production capacity is accepted.
